lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hA2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 A := hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)
  have hA3 : ContDiff ℝ 3 A := hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)
  have hEs (j : Fin d) : ContDiff ℝ 2 (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) :=
    electricField_apply_contDiff_space hA3 t
  have hEd (j k : Fin d) := Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hB (j : Fin d) := magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) A hA3 (j, i)
  have hBt (j : Fin d) := Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j) (hB j) x
  have hJt := LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time
    (c := 𝓕.c) (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) x i
  have hd (j : Fin d) :
      ∂ₜ (fun s => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) t =
        ∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x -
        ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x := by
    rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (hB j)]
    conv_lhs => enter [2, y]; rw [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A hA2]
    rw [Space.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub (hEd i j).differentiableAt
      (hEd j i).differentiableAt]
    change ∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x -
      ∂[j] (∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x = _
    rw [Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs j)]
  have hg : (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) =
      (fun y => J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t y / 𝓕.ε₀) :=
    funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1
  have hs : ∑ j, ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x =
      ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x / 𝓕.ε₀ := by
    trans ∂[i] (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) x
    · rw [Space.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt,
        _root_.sum_apply]
      rfl
    · rw [hg]
      simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, Space.deriv_eq]
      rw [fderiv_mul_const
        (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
          (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) t).differentiableAt]
      simp only [_root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time hA2 x),
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  rw [Time.deriv_eq,
    fderiv_fun_sub ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt
      (hJt.const_mul _).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt,
    fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt]
  simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, _root_.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Time.deriv_eq, hd, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hs, FreeSpace.c_sq]
  field_simp
